summary_bullets: Allow larch-log write-round to commit scout raw-output sidecars alongside scout manifests.
Document scout raw sidecar preservation and committed round-log behavior.
Cover raw sidecar preservation in scout tests and committed write-round copying in larch-log tests.
commit_message:
Commit scout raw sidecar artifacts

Allow write-round to include scout-round*-manifest.json.raw files so raw scout subprocess output is preserved in committed round logs. Update scout and larch-log contracts, and add regression assertions for raw sidecar preservation and copying.
